title: tetradenia japonica
intro: Tetradenia japonica, commonly known as Japanese Tetradenia or Japanese Coleus, is a plant species native to East Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Tetradenia japonica include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, diterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
